name: Safe to School
summary:
S2S: Safe to School is a virtual reality–based pedestrian safety training application designed to improve road-crossing behaviour among school-aged children through immersive, scenario-driven learning. Developed using the Unity engine and optimised for head-mounted displays such as Oculus Quest 3, the system replicates realistic urban traffic environments representative of Indian road conditions.
